claimBoundary: This profile qualifies a package-only complete-input progressive grayscale JPEG slice: 8-bit SOF2, one 1x1 component, Huffman coding, 8-bit DQT, default libjpeg-turbo simple progression, and no DNL. It does not yet qualify color JPEG, arbitrary progressive scan scripts, incremental suspension or a public backend.

The resource model is explicit: caller-owned encoded bytes are borrowed; ImageCraft admits width*height final grayscale bytes, a full quantized Int16 coefficient plane of ceil(width/8)*ceil(height/8)*64*2 bytes, and 448 fixed state bytes before allocation. The fixed state is one 128-byte natural-order quantization table, one 256-byte ISLOW workspace, and 64 bytes of per-coefficient progression state.

Every generated case must structurally contain the pinned libjpeg-turbo default six grayscale progressive scans, must match pinned djpeg -grayscale -dct int byte-for-byte, and must accept the exact operation charge while rejecting charge-1 before state/output allocation.

Two pinned cjpeg scan scripts extend the default domain: one applies DC first at Al=2 followed by two DC refinements plus split AC first/refine bands, and one partitions the complete AC spectrum without successive approximation. Restart variants additionally combine the default six-scan script with DRI/RST intervals of 1, 2 and 5 MCUs.

Passing establishes final complete-input entropy/refinement/reconstruction conformance for the qualified default/custom/restart domain. It does not establish chunk suspension rollback, arbitrary DHT/DQT mutation policies, malformed-stream equivalence, or preview-generation semantics.
